items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...my name is Bill Russell of course... And that was Mrs. Long. My first name is Isabella, is that? [INTERVIEWEE] No, Alice T. O. Long.

ctx.x: That's right. You could just reach up there and catch the naked, squeeze it up a little bit, pull it out, or push it in. That's the difference there was in that. And if you're using the B flat clarinet, because you had to play that A and C, D, well that's a D-partone clarinet, all together.

Well this is just about out here, about a half a minute. I don't believe there's anything else to do. I think you have to ask, but I'll mention on here too that the date is October 26, 1960, and we're at Mr. T. O.'s home. It's 24, 24 London. That's right. And the other members of the interviewing team here, my name is Bill Russell of course, and Ralph Collins is here, and Mr. Harold Dajon is helping us out very kindly tonight too. And that was Mrs. Long. My first name is Isabella, is that?
